title: seeFinancialData OFF strips sellPrice/cost/margin from JSON API responses
preconds: Build with CRP-BE-09 deployed. Test user on a role with seeFinancialData OFF.
steps:
1. Authenticate as the test user.
2. Hit GET on a WO list endpoint and on a WO detail endpoint.
3. Inspect the JSON response keys.
4. Look for sellPrice, cost, margin, or other pricing-related keys on WO lines.
5. Hit GET on Part Sales (if user has PART_SALES_VIEW — note: requires SEE_FINANCIAL_DATA, so configure differently if needed) and Invoicing and Payments endpoints.
expected: JSON payloads do NOT include sellPrice/cost/margin keys. Serializer group masking is applied uniformly.
